segments.text: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

segments.speaker: Scribes and Pharisees
segments.text: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
But he answered and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
¶ And he called the multitude,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
Then came his disciples, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
But he answered and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
Then answered Peter and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Peter
segments.text: Declare unto us this parable.
And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
¶ Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

heading: The Faith of a Canaanite Woman

segments.text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying,

segments.speaker: A Canaanite woman
segments.text: Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying,

segments.speaker: His disciples
segments.text: Send her away; for she crieth after us.
But he answered and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Then came she and worshipped him, saying,

segments.speaker: Canaanite woman
segments.text: Lord, help me.
But he answered and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
And she said,

segments.speaker: Canaanite Woman
segments.text: Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt.
And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:
Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
¶ Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
And his disciples say unto him,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
And Jesus saith unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: How many loaves have ye?
And they said,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: Seven, and a few little fishes.
And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
